artist_notes.name: Dave Aju
artist_notes.note: SF producer (Marc Barrite), Circus Company artist — soulful, left-field house built from his own vocals; played Fabric and Panorama Bar.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo, house and dancefloor edits.

artist_notes.name: SONNS
artist_notes.note: LA underground fixture behind Making Shapes and In Between; releases on Machine Limited and Kompakt.

artist_notes.name: Goddollars
artist_notes.note: Loren Granich, Rhonda co-founder and resident — sexy house-and-disco.

curator_note: Rhonda and In Between teaming up on an album release is about as close to a family reunion as this scene gets, and Dave Aju playing a free-ish 10am-to-4am marathon is the kind of deep booking you plan around. Venue is still TBA, so keep an eye out.
description: Day-into-night album release party for Navid Izadi's Ayande, presented by Rhonda Intl and In Between, with house and disco from Dave Aju, Masha Mar, SONNS and Goddollars.

artist_notes.name: Heidi Lawden
artist_notes.note: LA-via-London selector from the '90s UK rave scene — marathon house/techno/disco sets and a longtime DJ Harvey tour collaborator.

curator_note: Mostly a Heidi Lawden night, and she is the reason to go: she plays long and patient, the kind of set that rewards staying till 5. Location is TBA, so expect a late reveal.
description: Overnight Extra Sensory and Vice house party at a to-be-announced LA location, headlined by Tom Peters and Heidi Lawden.

artist_notes.name: Kana Hishiya
artist_notes.note: Japan-born, LA-based DJ/producer — house and techno from punchy minimal to broken-beat; played MEOKO and Sirens LA podcasts.

curator_note: A secret-location DTLA party skewing trance-tinged minimal and techno, with Kana Hishiya the most proven name on the bill. Worth it if you're after a darker, more hypnotic room than the usual house crowd.
description: Information program's late-night techno and minimal party at an undisclosed DTLA location.

curator_note: Tenhouse's Physical leans downtempo and dub techno, so it's an easier, earlier night than the usual 5am TBA warehouse. Free with RSVP, which makes it a low-risk way to try something.
description: Tenhouse's Physical night at a TBA DTLA location with dub techno and downtempo from pollensource, Naomi Green and others; free with RSVP.

curator_note: No lineup posted, so this is a bet on the concept: a house-and-disco night at El Cid, ten minutes from home. Free before 10 with RSVP, so the downside is a couple of drinks.
description: Recurring house and disco party at El Cid in Silver Lake; free with RSVP before 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Boys Noize
artist_notes.note: Berlin electro/techno veteran (Alex Ridha), founder of Boysnoize Records — distorted, industrial-leaning club music since the mid-2000s.

curator_note: This is a talk, not a set, but Boys Noize in a Grammy Museum room is a rare chance to hear him on process and history. It's Monday night and the 'plus' suggests some performance or a guest, though I couldn't verify what.
description: Onstage conversation with Boys Noize at the Grammy Museum at L.A. Live.

curator_note: Blind Tiger's Sunday-night afters at the Lexington, no lineup listed. Tonight only, free before 1 with RSVP, so a spur-of-the-moment option if you want tech-house and minimal into the small hours.
description: Blind Tiger's late-night after-hours tech-house and minimal party at the Lexington in DTLA.

curator_note: Goth-industrial-techno costume rave at 1720, with no lineup yet. Fun if you like the darker, theatrical side; harder and more aesthetic-driven than the groovy European nights.
description: Goth and industrial techno party from Nowwhere to Run and SOS at 1720 in the Arts District.

artist_notes.name: J.dB
artist_notes.note: Local DJ also on the Physical bill; no further detail verified.

curator_note: Grotto is a dub techno and minimal night with a four-name local bill and a TBA DTLA location. Deep and slow-burning, so go for the room and the sound system rather than a headliner.
description: Grotto's dub techno and minimal night at a TBA DTLA location with Hewan Aman, Matas, J.dB and Miracles.
